name: Rasagiline
metabolism: CYP1A2 mediates N-dealkylation and hydroxylation, producing aminoindan derivatives. Subsequent glucuronidation and excretion in urine are major how fast the body clears it steps.
summary: Rasagiline is an oral selective monoamine oxidase B inhibitor used to treat Parkinson's disease, either alone in early disease or as add-on therapy in more advanced cases.
